mapper.select: SELECT c.conv_id, c.user_a_id, c.user_b_id, c.last_msg_id, c.last_msg_time, c.related_product_id, c.tenant_id, CASE WHEN c.user_a_id = #{userId} THEN c.user_b_id ELSE c.user_a_id END AS peer_id, CASE WHEN c.user_a_id = #{userId} THEN ub.nick_name ELSE ua.nick_name END AS peer_nick_name, CASE WHEN c.user_a_id = #{userId} THEN ub.avatar ELSE ua.avatar END AS peer_avatar, (SELECT m.content FROM im_message m WHERE m.msg_id = c.last_msg_id) AS last_content, (SELECT m.type FROM im_message m WHERE m.msg_id = c.last_msg_id) AS last_type, p.title AS product_title, p.cover AS product_cover, p.price AS product_price FROM im_conversation c LEFT JOIN sys_user ua ON c.user_a_id = ua.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ub ON c.user_b_id = ub.user_id LEFT JOIN product p ON c.related_product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.user_a_id = #{userId} OR c.user_b_id = #{userId} AND c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY c.last_msg_time DESC
SELECT conv_id FROM im_conversation WHERE user_a_id = #{userAId} AND user_b_id = #{userBId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_conversation (user_a_id, user_b_id, related_product_id, last_msg_time, create_time, update_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{userAId}, #{userBId}, #{relatedProductId}, sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate() , #{tenantId})
